reviewed.claim: Only the exact EU HTTPS batch endpoint is accepted for cloud mode; default Android TLS/hostname verification remains; redirects disabled. Local loopback mode remains available.

Private config is loaded from the app sandbox, strict keys and value types checked, and endpoint/key/run/limit binding stored privately. Missing/changed config after binding blocks startup without loopback fallback. No key or binding digest is included in writeState or synthetic audit.

Final serialized payload is validated against the same event/property contract before transport. Public audit replaces the project token with a redaction marker; arbitrary server response text and exception messages are not emitted.

Reserved row count and attempt ID commit together before opening a connection. The same gate covers request-body write and durable revocation. Reservations have no refund and are not reset by consent/revocation/restart.
Cloud response classification requires integer status1. Quota-limited, unrecognized200 and HTTP3xx/4xx responses persist a transport block; audit failures also persist a block.
The deliberate single-ACK-discard decision is persisted before subsequent retry; it is not described as actual network ACK loss. Event UUID/timestamp remain in stored rows.
Seven new native self-checks test four budget arithmetic cases and three response classification cases. Local harness now requires the exact fourteen-key result and aligned build scope/permissions.
Startup UI no longer falsely labels the cloud-capable app Loopback only.

Cloud activation requires explicit manual nonempty gate; push/default manual runs stay local. Credential environment is scoped to preparation; files use private permissions and credentials enter Android via stdin, not argv or intent. Local suite failure stops before cloud.

Gate binds exact source/run/execution/first attempt and current explicit privacy/retention/deletion/quota/local-regression evidence. Missing controls or stale gate reject before cloud harness ADB operations. Gate is an operator attestation, not independent authentication of its referenced account settings.

One cloud installation and run are used without phase resets. Critical offline/consent/restart/sentinel/transport failures now stop dependent grants/reconnections. Offline needs the native active-network/capability probe, not only an airplane-mode command.

Attempt reconciliation checks reservation totals, ordered unique phases, response/final flags and eventual per-ID transport acknowledgement. No-response code0 matches Java. A failed reserved attempt followed by success keeps its budget charge.

On failure, after stopping the process the harness attempts to recover safe partial audit records and the last persisted state without relaunching. A stale snapshot is not refund authority; unknown consumption uses the entire remaining budget. Cleanup/export errors have safe reason handling.

Readback queries preserve raw row multiplicity and select by run OR distinct_id OR attested UUID within an explicit date window. A separate same-predicate count checks completeness at cap500. The normalizer preserves rows and parses properties JSON deterministically.

Readback checks independent event UUID ownership, unchanged UUID/timestamp, normal/new duplicates, revoked and unexpected IDs; unknown metadata values and unattested UUIDs are redacted and flagged for review.

Cloud prewrite public output does not mislabel the real credential as a fake token: it removes the redacted API-key entry while retaining envelope keys and a credential-redacted marker. The unchanged fake-token auditor is reused only in memory.
Exporter enumerates only public receipt paths, excludes cloud-private, reparses and serializes JSON/JSONL, rejects unsafe credentials/duplicates/nonfinite scalars and preserves repeated event rows.

resolved_during_review: Quota-limited or unknown success previously retried; now a persistent transport block is written.
Number.intValue previously accepted fractional status values; now exact Integer1 is required.
Audit failures now block even if a later finished-record append succeeds.
Local builder/verifier scope and fourteen native SELF_CHECKS were mismatched; now aligned.
Initial UI label was misleading for cloud mode; now neutral.
Critical phase checks initially accumulated failures but continued; now they stop dependent activity.
Transport summaries initially tolerated missing response/finished records; they now require phase and acknowledgement consistency.
Missing-response code was initially mismatched at0native versus-1harness; now aligned to0 with a recovery fixture.
Cleanup/export failures could preempt a safe receipt; guarded finalization and conservative partial evidence handling added.
Client UUID reuse across different business IDs could conceal later cloud deduplication losses; now rejected.
Unattested cloud UUID values were publicly emitted; now redacted.
Raw query selection, count evidence and connector table adaptation were strengthened without removing duplicate rows.
coverage_limits: No Android build/execution, cloud send, PostHog project query or live credential access was performed by this reviewer.

The planned local regression uses cloudMode=false. It can attest preserved local behavior and execution of the pure self-check functions; it does not exercise actual cloud reservation, HTTPS, private config binding, persistent ACK discard or failure blocking.
The Python test fixtures derive their preflight shape from SELF_CHECKS. Their success alone does not attest the compiled native JSON shape; the next Android run must do that.
Budget predicate checks are not storage transaction, crash or restart tests. The durable reservation ordering is a source finding until the actual cloud path is exercised.

cloud_rows_written/body_written are recorded after completing the body write. A crash in between can undercount possible transmissions; only committed reserved rows provide the conservative upper bound.
An external authorization ledger must cover new jobs, reinstallations and manual reruns. The app SQLite budget cannot survive clearing its own app data.
The request before durable revoke commit remains unaccepted and may recover previous consent. Already dispatched bytes cannot be recalled.
Response predicate checks do not exercise real HTTP failures, timeout/EOF, oversized responses, TLS or upstream quota behavior.
AOSP Android15/API35 source review supports nonreplay of a fixed-length streaming body after write; it is not an attestation of every OEM or the exact system-image fingerprint.
Preflight records serialized event body content before HTTPS, not independently captured TLS wire bytes/headers. Cloud ingestion and enrichment require separate connector readback.

The actual project, key-to-project match, free quota, effective retention/deletion access, IP-discard setting and metadata remain pre-send gates; no generic documentation or code check attests those account settings.
Host evidence-guard tests are not Android cloud-path tests. This reviewer inspected their assertions but did not execute tests or a workflow.

The normalized readback wrapper contains caller-supplied response references and hashes. During a real run the reviewer must compare these to original connector responses, including schema, pagination, cache/freshness and completeness. The CLI does not authenticate external provenance.
The query uses a five-minute clock margin and an explicit bounded timestamp window. It cannot exclude server changes that move an event outside that window.
One row observed per retried UUID is compatible with cloud deduplication, not proof that all transmitted copies were separately ingested. Immediate and later snapshots must remain distinct.
Native prewrite metadata and HTTPS endpoint selection are source/prewrite evidence, not decrypted wire captures of actual cloud headers.
Failures before the cloud harness starts (gate preparation or wrapper setup) may have only a constant safe job-log reason; no event has been sent by that path.
The new permission is ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE only in the synthetic LAB APK. It does not prove physical radio behavior or phone battery cost.
required_before_cloud_execution: Complete account-specific destination/access/privacy/retention/deletion/free-quota checks without new accounts or spend.
Reconcile raw connector rows without DISTINCT or query-side deduplication, retaining UUID/event/timestamp/distinct_id and metadata differences; HTTP200 alone is not delivery.
Preserve scope distinction between accepted durable revocation, precommit interruption, already-dispatched requests, copies attempted and rows observable after possible cloud deduplication.

Run and independently review the exact-source local Android regression; then exercise the cloud path only after all account-specific gates are actually verified and the global remaining budget is recorded.
